subject: website
name: Reneil
summary: The personal homepage of Reneil, with its own scripts (jQuery and a template). No public repository for the site was found. It is Level 2: six YouTube players load as the page opens and bring Google's ad and tracking requests (doubleclick, google.com scripts), and it loads Google Fonts.

connections.name: YouTube embeds (youtube.com, doubleclick.net, ytimg.com)
connections.note: Six players load when the page opens, with Google ad and tracking requests.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens; tells Google the visit.
